_comment: Findings adjudicated by a human as correct despite the checker flagging them. Keyed '<identifier>|<canonical name>'. --gate ignores these; the report still lists them so an entry stays visible rather than silently rotting. The checker itself clears a paper that names the row's target together with a class sibling or the series' collective noun, and a reference compound in a paper about its class (citation_topicality._series_evidence); it never accuses through a street alias or a journal name, and it reads a spaced research code ('WIN 35,428') as one name (build_index). An entry here is a finding none of those rules can see.
_series: the paper names the series, not each member

_full-text-only: the compound is in a table or the body, and the abstract this check reads names it nowhere. Confirmed by reading the open-access full text, or by ChEMBL having extracted the row's exact value from this document.
_JWH-073 is Table 1's N-butyl indole: CB1 Ki 8.90 ± 1.80 nM, CB2 38.0 ± 24.0 nM, the rows' values (full text, 2026-10-31)
_WIN 35,428 is the 4'-fluoro methyl ester in the tables; ChEMBL CHEMBL1128444 extracted its [3H]DA/NE/5-HT uptake-inhibition Ki 22.95/38.59/100.56 nM from this paper
_Table 1 lists clonazepam as the [3H]flunitrazepam reference compound at Ki 2.00 nM; ChEMBL CHEMBL1147348 extracted the same value
_the paper's deposited screen holds temazepam's rat Gabra1 AC50 of 44.0 nM; ChEMBL CHEMBL5291721 extracted it from this document
_the next seven name the substance and state the row's claim only in the body or a table; checked against the papers-cache full text 2026-10-31, which the gate reads locally but CI does not have
_unrelated-alias: the checker matched an alias in the paper, not the row's claim; adjudicated by the dose-gates pass 2026-10-30
_synonym: the paper names the substance by a name the index does not carry
_all-trans retinoic acid is tretinoin; the abstract states its plasma half-life as 0.8 ± 0.1 h, the row's 48 min
_the label is Diastat's diazepam rectal gel; its 'Product label' title names nothing, while the text states F 90%, peak at 1.5 h and t1/2 about 46 h, the row's values
